# Providers

freeflow ships with 58 providers. Use a model as `<provider>/<model id>`, for example `groq/llama-3.3-70b-versatile`.
Keys can be added in the admin page, with `freeflow key <provider>`, or through the environment variable listed.

## Local servers (3)

No key needed. Start the server, then use the model id it reports.

| Provider | Id | Key variable | Example model | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ollama | `ollama` | none | `ollama/qwen3-coder` |  |
| LM Studio | `lmstudio` | none | `lmstudio/<loaded-model>` |  |
| llama.cpp server | `llamacpp` | none | `llamacpp/<model>` |  |

## Your own endpoint

Any server that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions API (vLLM, SGLang, LiteLLM, a company gateway) or the Anthropic Messages API can be added from **Providers → Custom endpoint**. Its id becomes the model prefix.
